**Chess Sikho** — offline Hinglish chess coach (native Android APK).

## Install kaise karein (2 minute)

1. Neeche se **`ChessSikho.apk`** download karo (phone me hi kholo is link ko).
2. Download pe tap karo. Android bolega *"Unknown sources se install allow karo"* → **Settings → Allow** kar do.
3. Install → app kholo. **Internet ki zaroorat nahi** — app poori tarah offline chalta hai.

Agar Play Protect warning aaye: **"More details" → "Install anyway"**. Ye APK GitHub pe khud build hota hai aur debug key se sign hota hai, isliye ye warning normal hai.

## Kya milta hai

- **🧠 Coach (guide mode)** — har position pe sabse achhi chaal + **kyu** chalni hai, Hinglish me
- **🔊 Voice guide** — coach bol ke sunata hai (native Android TTS, Hindi/Indian English)
- **🎯 Opponent ki expected chaalein** — probability % ke saath, aur har ek ka **jawab** kya hoga
- **⚠️ Threat alert** — kaunsa piece free me ja raha hai, kaunsi chaal se nuksan hoga
- **💰 Capture hisaab** — trade lena chahiye ya nahi (SEE based, +/− material me)
- **📖 Opening book** — Italian, London System, Caro-Kann, Sicilian, Queen's Gambit… har ek ka plan + trap
- **📚 15 Hinglish lessons** (~3000 shabd) + 15-min crash course mode
- **🧩 8 mate-in-1 puzzles** + 1 trap puzzle
- **♟️ 4 level ka bot**, undo, hint, board flip, move list, captured pieces

## Permissions

Koi permission nahi. Na internet, na location, na contacts. Data phone me hi rehta hai.

## Web version

Wahi app browser me bhi chalta hai — repo me `chess-sikho/` folder, ya `python3 chess-sikho/serve.py 8000`.
